title: Build Buddy
tagline: Run the route. Build the way.
description: A momentum platformer where one player runs the route and the other places platforms, springs, and checkpoints to build it. Play local co-op on one screen (keyboard runner, mouse builder), practice any unlocked stage, or match up online via public matchmaking or private room codes. Two ten-stage packs: the Construction Zone and the Harbor, where floating spike balls ride their cables through every course.
status: Playable - shared-screen local co-op, practice, and online 2P co-op across two 10-stage packs (Construction Zone, Harbor)
